key_insight: A closed-loop optimizer calibrates atomistic GaAs growth kinetics directly from experimental growth data, reducing reliance on costly DFT-derived rate parameters.
engineering_relevance: The framework turns routine MOCVD growth measurements into mechanistically interpretable models that could support process optimization with fewer experimental iterations.
method: Simulate atomistic deposition events using kinetic Monte Carlo.
Optimize kinetic rate parameters with Monte Carlo Tree Search.
Guide the search using each parameter’s degree of rate control.
evidence_signal: For GaAs MOCVD, the calibrated model captures measured growth-rate temperature dependence and recovers three known kinetic regimes involving shifts in the rate-determining step.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish whether growth-rate calibration uniquely identifies kinetic parameters or predicts conditions beyond the calibration data.
paper_title: Atomistic Insights into MOCVD Growth of GaAs using a Closed Loop Autonomous System Combining Directed Reinforcement Learning and Kinetic Monte Carlo Simulations
